long_biography.plain_text:
Opening senior roles to managers from outside the family was central to Luca Pretto’s changes at Pasubio. He moved from personally directing tasks to organising a team responsible for execution, while retaining the discipline of an owner assessing business plans. His approach also brought expertise from outside the tanning industry.

Pretto pursued a separate interest in food with Claudio Troiani, developing a gelato business in Vicenza. Their production method combined a central laboratory for preparing ingredients with final churning at individual shops. The pair travelled to select small producers, including suppliers of milk, fruit and nuts, for their recipes.
